gse244832.allowed_use: External-development unpaired integration evaluation only. Use SCGLUE, not paired obs-name matching, because RNA and ATAC are same-sample different aliquots.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 matrices, labels, graph construction, balancing weights, preprocessing, model fitting, decode defaults, or calibration may enter a model scored on it.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time RNA-only inductive embedding and frozen cell-state head after selection lock; no ATAC profile confirmation is possible.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA features only; no labels, outcomes, graph changes, query fitting, cell-type supervision, or calibration before prediction hashes are committed.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-fold unpaired SCGLUE and native PairedSCGLUE development lanes after donor/barcode/well/reference activation gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors define HVGs, LSI/PCA, gene-peak graph, balancing weights, batches, cell-type supervision, network parameters, early stopping, heads, or calibration. Held-donor RNA may be encoded without fitting.

local_model_roster.common_lane: SCGLUE posterior-mean RNA embedding with no cell-type supervision and an identical common head
local_model_roster.native_lane: PairedSCGLUE only for validated same-nucleus GSE296875 training rows; report separately
local_model_roster.experimental_lane: RNA-to-ATAC decode_data is unscored until its defaults and fixture are added to the shared TaskSpec

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; use unpaired SCGLUE and distinct row identifiers
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; PairedSCGLUE use_obs_names allowed only after join validation

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, nuclei, and graph edges are not independent biological replicates.
rules.guidance_graph: Construct and hash the graph within each outer-training partition. Never call a prior edge a causal regulatory relationship.
rules.serialization: No external dill loading. Local checkpoints require a state-dict adapter and exact graph/feature/config manifest.
rules.supervision: Evaluation labels cannot enter encoders. Training-donor cell-type supervision, if evaluated, belongs only to a separately declared native lane.
